title: GPU Health Operator — Mini Dashboard & Policy Composer
creator: Aisha Chen
description: Design and prototype a compact operator-facing dashboard that surfaces a GPU pool health scorecard, live autoscale controls, and a lightweight policy composer for burst/priority rules. The mini dashboard should slot into the Dedicated -> Pool view as an optional right-hand rail for operators and SREs who need rapid triage and safe manual interventions. Deliverables: high-fidelity Figma screens, an interactive prototype with three policy templates (cost-preserving, latency-priority, emergency-burst), an accessibility pass, and a short handoff doc for product and front-end engineers.
goals: Provide a single-pane triage view: aggregate health signals (utilization, queue latency, recent fallsbacks, kernel errors)
Expose safe manual controls for autoscale and burst with explicit rollback paths
Allow operators to compose and preview policy changes with cost and latency delta estimations
Keep the control surface compact — fits within existing pool list/detail pages without reflowing core layout
acceptance_criteria: Figma screens for collapsed / expanded mini dashboard reviewed and approved by PM and Eng
Interactive prototype demonstrates policy composer flow including validation, preview, and commit
Design tokens and CSS spec provided for implementation (colors, spacing, iconography)
Accessibility checklist completed: keyboard nav, color contrast >= 4.5:1 for key indicators
Hand-off doc contains mappings to backend toggles and expected API shapes for safe rollout
design_review_feedback: 2026-03-05 - PM (Priya Kapoor): Prefer explicit cost delta in preview; show both tokenized and aggregated estimates
2026-03-07 - Eng (Liam O'Connor): Need clear API contract for 'preview' endpoint; avoid heavy client-side simulation
2026-03-09 - Accessibility (Rashida Ahmed): Ensure focus order of composer modal and include aria-live updates for health score changes
2026-03-12 - Security (Jon Park): Confirm RBAC gating for manual burst; add audit log requirement to handoff
decisions: Keep mini dashboard opt-in per pool to avoid UI noise; controlled by a pool-level feature flag
Preview calls will be server-side only (ENG to implement a read-only preview endpoint) to ensure cost/latency estimates match runtime logic
Burst action requires two-step confirmation with explicit expiry and automatic rollback option
Policy composer will support three templates at launch, with JSON advanced mode hidden behind a toggle for power users
